acceptance_criteria: Do not show zones with status IN (closed, archived) or zones covered by campsite_closures; calculate total tents_needed and total capacity_max for effective Trips by zone_id and stay_date; allow selection only when max_tents and max_people are not exceeded.

A Trip has route, title, trip_type = day_trip or overnight, start/end time, meeting point, booking deadline, minimum/maximum capacity, and price; starts_at < ends_at; a new Trip has status = pending_approval.

Each night has night_number, stay_date, zone_id, and tents_needed; night_number and stay_date cannot duplicate within the same Trip; row count equals duration_nights; day_trip Trips have no trip_camp_stays; capacity is checked using CTMS-31.

Only Trips with status = pending_approval and valid data can move to status = published; overnight Trips must have complete trip_camp_stays. If not approved, keep status = pending_approval for Host edits and save the reason in audit_logs/notifications; cancelled Trips move to status = cancelled. Do not use rejected.

Booking creation or confirmation runs in a transaction; lock by trip_id when updating seats_taken; lock by zone_id when checking trip_camp_stays; total people cannot exceed capacity_max or max_people and total tents cannot exceed max_tents; conflicting transactions must roll back.

Only Trips with status = published are shown; filtering supports time, trip_type, difficulty, price, and route; details show starts_at, ends_at, meeting_point, price, remaining seats, includes/excludes, and latest risk level.

story_title: View Risk Level Before Trekking Registration
acceptance_criteria: The route page shows Green, Yellow, or Red risk, last updated time, and recommendation.

Only the owning Host can edit; after a Trip is published, changes to starts_at, ends_at, capacity, and trip_camp_stays must check impact on bookings, Porters, equipment, and zones; important changes are audit logged and notified.
The Host can add, delete, and reorder trip_media; each media item has a URL, type, and order; only the owning Host can update the Trip when trips.status NOT IN (ongoing, completed).

Bookings are created only for Trips with status = published, before booking_deadline, not at Weather Risk Red, and with enough seats; date, price, and cancellation policy snapshots are saved. Free Trips create bookings.status = confirmed and payment_status = not_required; paid Trips create bookings.status = pending_payment and payment_status = unpaid.

booking_members contains all participants, including the booking owner; each booking has exactly one is_primary = true; num_people equals booking_members count; duplicate users are not allowed in the same booking and Trip capacity cannot be exceeded.
Show booking code, Trip, route, time, member list, price, surcharges, rented equipment, payment_status, and booking_status; do not show campsite slots.

Create a payment transaction with a unique idempotency_key; payments.status uses pending, succeeded, or failed. On success, bookings.payment_status = paid and bookings.status = confirmed; duplicate transactions are not recorded twice.

Bookings with status = pending_payment past hold_expires_at move to expired; seats_taken is reduced if the booking held seats; related equipment_reservations with status = reserved move to cancelled; write audit_logs with action = booking_expired, target_type = booking, target_id = booking_id, actor_id = NULL, before_value, after_value, and reason; then notify the booking owner.

Cancellation fees are calculated from cancellation_policy_snapshot; bookings.status, cancelled_at, and cancelled_by are updated; seats_taken is reduced; active equipment_reservations are released; write audit_logs with action = booking_cancelled, target_type = booking, target_id = booking_id, actor_id as the actor, before_value, after_value, and reason.
Create a refund transaction linked to the booking; update bookings.payment_status to refunded or partially_refunded and payments.status to refunded; do not refund twice; save transaction_ref.

After booking_deadline, if seats_taken < capacity_min then trips.status = cancelled; trip_camp_stays no longer occupy zones; equipment_reservations are released; bookings are cancelled and refunds are processed.

Only bookings with status = confirmed can be checked in; update booking_members.member_status = joined and checked_in_at for each member; booking remains confirmed; do not check in members with member_status = removed or bookings with status IN (cancelled, expired).

Update booking_members.member_status = left and left_at; booking moves to completed only after the Trip has ended and members are processed; rented equipment is checked as returned or recorded as not returned; reviews are then enabled.

After departure time, members with member_status = registered who have not checked in can move to member_status = no_show; save actor and timestamp; booking has no no_show status because this state belongs to each booking_member.
Save booking_items with item_type, ref_id, quantity, and price; update surcharge and total_amount; rented equipment is not stored in booking_items and must use equipment_reservations.

Create and edit equipment catalog entries; do not use soft delete because equipment has no deleted_at column. When removed from service, move equipment.status to maintenance, lost, or retired depending on context; save quantity_total, rental_price_per_day, deposit_amount, storage_location, and maintenance_schedule.
Only equipment available for the selected dates is shown; rental fees are calculated; quantity cannot be overbooked.

story_title: Record Equipment Handover at Check In
acceptance_criteria: On handover, update equipment_reservations.status = picked_up and picked_up_at; if a specific item is assigned, update equipment_items.status = in_use. Do not change the entire equipment type record to in_use; save recipient and handover time.

story_title: Record Damaged, Lost, or Returned Equipment
acceptance_criteria: On return, update equipment_reservations.status = returned and specific good-condition items to status = available; damaged items move equipment_items.status = maintenance and create equipment_damage_logs; lost items move to status = lost; overdue unreturned reservations move reservation.status = not_returned.

story_title: Receive Personalized Packing List for Trip
acceptance_criteria: The list is based on weather, duration, difficulty, and rented equipment; items are categorized as mandatory or recommended.

Save experience_years, certifications, languages, and availability_status in porter_profiles; do not store operating areas in porter_profiles because campsite operations are managed through campsite_porters and campsite invitations.
Filters support schedule, route, experience, and status; Porters with schedule conflicts are not shown.
Create campsite_porters with status = invited; duplicate campsite_id and porter_id pairs are not allowed; save invited_by and day_rate; the Porter receives a notification.

Porters can respond only to their own invitations; accepting changes campsite_porters.status to active and records joined_at; declining or leaving changes status to removed; pausing changes status to paused; the Host receives a notification.

Only Porters with campsite_porters.status = active at the route campsite can be assigned proficiency; porter_routes.proficiency uses learning, proficient, or expert; save times_led, verified_by, and verified_at; each Porter has only one profile per route.

Only Porters with campsite_porters.status = active at the route starting campsite can be assigned; the lead Porter must have proficiency IN (proficient, expert); overlapping work_range with porter_assignments status IN (pending, accepted) is not allowed; send a notification for the Porter to accept or reject.
Show schedule, route, members, checkpoints, weather, and offline package download status.
Incident type, description, location, and optional images are captured; the incident is saved offline when network is unavailable.
